'''Keb Nevrunn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He flew the [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] ''[[Lunatic Fringer]]'', and was a friend of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Renna (Rodian)|Renna]] for many years.

{{RPG}}
In c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Nevrunn was hired by Renna to transport the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance [[Agent/Legends|agents]] who were on a mission for [[Renna's Transport Service]], aboard the ''Lunatic Fringer''. However, while the they were returning from the mission, the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] became caught in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]] due to the actions of a [[shadow creature]], which was draining passing starships of power.
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Nevrunn was bitter, surly and wise-cracking, and while he had a critical eye, he also had a heart of gold. He wasn't very good at remembering names, but made a special effort to remember the names of attractive [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Near-Human]]s.

==Behind the scenes==
The Keb Nevrunn appears in the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philosophy|Philosophy]]'', and is assigned to transport the players&mdash;who role-play as the Heroes of Cularin&mdash;if the player characters do not own a starship of their own and do not have the skills to fly one.
